'''Torpo the Hutt''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and distant cousin of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Torpo was suspected by Jabba for brokering a deal with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to access the [[Valsedian asteroid belt]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], which was in violation of a treaty made with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] concerning supply routes. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was requested to and dispatched a team consisting of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Keelyvine Reus]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Tyzen Xebec]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to the Valsedian asteroid belt to investigate and negotiate a resolution to the situation. He was later found in a room where he begged for the Jedi to help him, but he was quickly stabbed in the back by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].
